general.languageDesc: The language used across the whole browser.
general.startModeDesc: Choose which pages open when the browser starts.
general.startPagesDesc: Addresses opened one after another at start.
general.restoreOnStartDesc: Reopen the tabs that were open when the browser was closed.
general.askWhereToSaveDesc: Choose the folder for every download.
general.confirmCloseMultipleDesc: Show a confirmation when several tabs are open.
general.homepageDesc: The page opened by the home button.
general.showHomeButtonDesc: Adds a home button next to the navigation buttons.
general.showBookmarksBarDesc: Displays a quick-access bar with your saved bookmarks below the address bar.

search.enginesDesc: Add as many engines as you like. Use {q} in the address for the query.
search.defaultEngineDesc: Which engine handles a plain word in the address bar.
search.suggestionsDesc: Show matching pages while you type.
search.historySuggestionsDesc: Include visited pages in the address bar.

appearance.themeDesc: Follow the system or pick one of the two modes.
appearance.accentDesc: Used for highlights, switches and buttons.
appearance.accentContrastDesc: Colour of text on coloured surfaces.
appearance.darkSurfaceDesc: Colour of bars, fields and panels.
appearance.lightSurfaceDesc: Colour of bars, fields and panels.
appearance.radiusDesc: How rounded corners and fields look.
appearance.densityDesc: How much space rows and bars take.
appearance.fontSizeDesc: Base size of the interface text.
appearance.customFontDesc: Your own font list, for example Inter, sans serif.
appearance.compactTitlebarDesc: Hides the top bar with the window buttons.

tabs.positionDesc: Where the list of tabs sits.
tabs.widthDesc: How wide a tab may grow.
tabs.showFaviconsDesc: Display the small site icon next to the title.
tabs.showCloseButtonDesc: Display the small cross inside each tab.
tabs.hoverCloseDesc: Keeps the tab bar calm until you point at a tab.
tabs.previewOnHoverDesc: Show the page title when hovering a tab.
tabs.openInBackground: Open new tabs in the background
tabs.openInBackgroundDesc: Links open beside the current tab.
tabs.confirmBeforeCloseDesc: Show a confirmation for every tab you close.
tabs.newTabPositionDesc: Where a new tab is placed in the list.
tabs.restoreClosedDesc: Allows reopening a tab you just closed.
tabs.maxUndoDesc: How many closed tabs can be reopened.

newtab.layoutDesc: How your quick links are arranged.
newtab.backgroundDesc: Address of an image shown behind the start page.
newtab.backgroundOverlayDesc: How strongly the image shows through.
newtab.showClockDesc: Time and date above the search field.
newtab.showSearchDesc: A search field in the middle of the start page.
newtab.showGreetingDesc: A short greeting that changes with the time of day.
newtab.searchTargetDesc: Address of your search engine. Use {q} for the query.
newtab.linksDesc: Your own pages on the start page.

privacy.blockTrackersDesc: Stops common tracking and measurement requests.
privacy.blockThirdPartyCookiesDesc: Sites cannot follow you across other sites.
privacy.blockThirdPartyMediaDesc: Blocks video and audio from other sites.
privacy.httpsOnlyDesc: Refuses to open plain http connections.
privacy.httpsFirstDesc: Tries the secure version of a page first.
privacy.doNotTrackDesc: Asks sites not to follow you.
privacy.stripReferrerDesc: Does not tell other sites where you came from.
privacy.disableHyperlinkAuditDesc: Pages cannot check where your links point.
privacy.clearOnExitDesc: Empty the history when the browser closes.
privacy.permissionsRememberDesc: Keeps your answers for each site.
privacy.geolocationDesc: What happens when a page asks for your position.
privacy.notificationsDesc: What happens when a page wants to notify you.
privacy.clipboardDesc: Permission to read or write the clipboard.
privacy.popupsDesc: New windows are turned into normal tabs.
privacy.allowedSitesDesc: One address per line. These sites are always loaded.
privacy.blockRulesDesc: One regular expression per line for requests to block.

content.javascriptDesc: Needed for most pages. Changing this restarts the browser.
content.imagesDesc: Images make pages slower but clearer.
content.spellcheckDesc: Underlines spelling mistakes while you type.
content.defaultFontSizeDesc: Base text size for every page.
content.defaultFontFamilyDesc: Your own typeface for every page.
content.lazyImagesDesc: Images load only when they come into view.
content.openLinksInNewTab: Open links in a new tab
content.openLinksInNewTabDesc: Links never replace the page you are reading.
content.markPdfLinksDesc: Adds a small hint to links that point at documents.
content.customCssDesc: Your own CSS applied to every page.
content.customCssEnabledDesc: Applies the stylesheet you wrote above.

network.proxyModeDesc: How the browser reaches the network.
network.proxyRulesDesc: Rules in the usual form, for example http=127.0.0.1:8080.
network.userAgentDesc: Replaces the name the browser sends to sites.
network.acceptLanguagesDesc: Sent to sites in the given order, for example de,en.

extensions.developerModeDesc: Shows details and tools for extension work.
extensions.allowUnpackedDesc: Needed before you can add an extension yourself.

data.bookmarksDesc: Pages you saved for quick access.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Click a shortcut and press the key combination you want.

advanced.hardwareAccelerationDesc: Faster rendering, but uses more power.
advanced.memorySaverDesc: Slows down tabs that have been hidden for a while.
advanced.memorySaverDelayDesc: How long a tab must be hidden before it slows down.
advanced.blockWebViewTagDesc: Stops pages from loading other pages inside a frame.
advanced.disableProtocolHandlersDesc: Open custom protocols in the browser instead of the system.
advanced.crashRecoveryDesc: Reopen the tabs that were open when the browser stopped.
advanced.loggingDesc: Writes technical details next to the other data.
